# The ingestion SUBMISSION-ACCEPTANCE tests that must execute and pass.
#
# Generated from jest, not typed by hand. These assert that a submission is
# ACCEPTED and returns a job id. They do NOT assert completed worker
# ingestion: no Celery worker runs in this job, jobs are left queued, and
# nothing here should be described as proving ingestion finished.
#
# Same gate as the conflict manifest: a rename shows up as one missing and
# one unexpected entry rather than a quietly smaller check.
createMemory against the real API a submission is accepted and returns a job id
createMemory against the real API two separate submissions get two different job ids
createMemory against the real API a retry reusing the original key is accepted
createMemory against the real API a malformed key is rejected — the header is really being read
